  "caseId": "OYS-20261110-009",
  "decision": "Insufficient evidence to recommend reuse or mechanical recycling. Assess whether the inserts remain fit for use and whether they can be safely cleaned and accepted for recycling before comparing the options.",
  "reasons": [
    "Remaining service life and suitability for reuse are unknown.",
    "Dust is stipulated, but residue composition, cleaning needs and hazardous contact are unknown.",
    "A defensible comparison needs a functional unit, system boundary and transport information."
  ],
  "evidence": [
    "The case describes fictional PP transport inserts retired after internal circulation.",
    "The stated 30 kg is a fictional scenario parameter, not a measurement.",
    "No field records, photos or external evidence were supplied."
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "No legal eligibility, recycler acceptance, price or emissions factor can be determined from the supplied case.",
    "No measured condition or contamination data are available."
  ]
}

effectiveInput.description: SYNTHETIC — newly authored text-only fictional scenario: Missing regional and comparison basis. No field records, photos or external evidence supplied. Mass is unknown. No legal eligibility, price or emissions factor is asserted.
effectiveInput.process: Fictional PET sheet cutting produces offcuts. The scenario asks about processing options and cost/carbon comparison, but mass, region, contamination history, quotations, factors, document versions and processor permit/code/service-area evidence are absent. No processor is named.

output.decision: Insufficient evidence to recommend a processing route or compare cost and carbon impacts.
reasons: The offcut mass, region and contamination history are unknown.
No processor, quotation, emissions factor or permit and service-area evidence is supplied.
evidence: The case describes fictional PET sheet-cutting offcuts.
The case supplies no photos, field records or external evidence.
limitations: The PET identification and offcut description are unverified.
Legal eligibility, processing availability, cost and emissions cannot be established from this case.
